name: Hermes Agent v3
author: Mox Neo
description: Hermes Agent v3 on Debian 12 (glibc 2.36, linux/amd64+arm64). Dashboard-first; per-server first login; no Panel keys. No Tailscale.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail cd /mnt/server # Fail loud on unsupported arch (install container). _m=$(uname -m) case "$_m" in x86_64|amd64) _a=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) _a=arm64 ;; *) echo "[hermes] unsupported arch: ${_m}"; exit 1 ;; esac echo "[hermes] install arch=${_a} uname=${_m}" cat > start.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail _m=$(uname -m) case "$_m" in x86_64|amd64) HERMES_ARCH=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) HERMES_ARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "[hermes] unsupported arch: ${_m}"; exit 1 ;; esac echo "[hermes] arch=${HERMES_ARCH} uname=${_m}" export HOME=/home/container export HERMES_HOME=/home/container/.hermes export PATH="$HERMES_HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" export TMPDIR="$HERMES_HOME/cache/scratch" cd /home/container mkdir -p "$HERMES_HOME" "$HOME/.local/bin" "$TMPDIR" umask 077 touch "$HERMES_HOME/.env" chmod 600 "$HERMES_HOME/.env" # ENABLE_*=0|1. Default on. Panel does not rewrite .env (UI owns it). # SERVER_PORT and HERMES_ENABLE_DASHBOARD are read here every start. flag_on() { [ "${1:-0}" = "1" ]; } if ! command -v hermes >/dev/null 2>&1; then # Pinned by full commit SHA + sha256 of install.sh (fail closed). HERMES_VERSION="${HERMES_VERSION:-f97608f178d1ffeca59860195ab7da295f7c8e5f}" HERMES_INSTALL_SHA256="${HERMES_INSTALL_SHA256:-2017ddf0cc7bc6cfb70d40dc9fba1d916f47dbcccf5fe73bdee2cf93a11262af}" if ! [[ "$HERMES_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then echo "[hermes] HERMES_VERSION must be a full 40-char commit SHA (got ${HERMES_VERSION})" exit 1 fi if ! [[ "$HERMES_INSTALL_SHA256" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then echo "[hermes] HERMES_INSTALL_SHA256 must be a 64-char sha256 of scripts/install.sh at that commit" exit 1 fi echo "[hermes] installing commit ${HERMES_VERSION} arch=${HERMES_ARCH}" INSTALL_SH="${TMPDIR}/hermes-install.sh" curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/${HERMES_VERSION}/scripts/install.sh" -o "$INSTALL_SH" if ! echo "${HERMES_INSTALL_SHA256} ${INSTALL_SH}" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[hermes] install.sh sha256 mismatch; refusing to run it" rm -f "$INSTALL_SH" exit 1 fi chmod +x "$INSTALL_SH" args=(--skip-setup --skip-browser --hermes-home "$HERMES_HOME" --dir "$HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent" --commit "$HERMES_VERSION") bash "$INSTALL_SH" "${args[@]}" export PATH="$HERMES_HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" if [ ! -d "$HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent" ]; then echo "[hermes] hermes-agent dir missing after install" exit 1 fi if [ ! -x "$HERMES_HOME/bin/uv" ]; then echo "[hermes] uv missing at $HERMES_HOME/bin/uv" exit 1 fi echo "[hermes] installing dashboard extra [web]" ( cd "$HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent" VIRTUAL_ENV="$HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent/venv" uv pip install -e ".[web]" ) fi if ! command -v hermes >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[hermes] binary missing PATH=$PATH" exit 1 fi # First boot always seeds the local custom model. Upstream config.yaml already # sets model.default (anthropic/claude-opus-4.6), so do not key off that value. # Later starts: V3_MODEL_SEEDED means the UI owns these three keys. if [ ! -f "$HERMES_HOME/V3_MODEL_SEEDED" ]; then echo "[hermes] seeding model.provider=custom model.default=local" hermes config set model.provider custom hermes config set model.default local hermes config set model.base_url http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 : > "$HERMES_HOME/V3_MODEL_SEEDED" chmod 600 "$HERMES_HOME/V3_MODEL_SEEDED" fi for bin in hermes hermes-agent hermes-acp; do if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/$bin" ]; then echo "[hermes] launcher missing: $bin" exit 1 fi done if flag_on "${HERMES_ENABLE_DASHBOARD:-1}"; then if [ -z "${SERVER_PORT:-}" ]; then echo "[hermes] dashboard ENABLE=1 needs SERVER_PORT" exit 1 fi fi # Seed dashboard auth only when the password is absent. Never overwrite later. _pw_line=$(grep -E '^HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD=' "$HERMES_HOME/.env" | tail -n 1 || true) _pw_val=${_pw_line#HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD=} _pw_val=${_pw_val#\"} _pw_val=${_pw_val%\"} _pw_val=${_pw_val#\'} _pw_val=${_pw_val%\'} if [ -z "$_pw_val" ]; then if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then _pw=$(openssl rand -hex 16) _secret=$(openssl rand -hex 32) else _pw=$(python3 -c 'import os; print(os.urandom(16).hex())') _secret=$(python3 -c 'import os; print(os.urandom(32).hex())') fi if [ "${#_pw}" -lt 20 ] || [ "${#_secret}" -lt 32 ]; then echo "[hermes] failed to generate dashboard auth" exit 1 fi set_env_key() { local key="$1" val="$2" tmp tmp="$HERMES_HOME/.env.tmp" grep -v "^${key}=" "$HERMES_HOME/.env" > "$tmp" || true printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$val" >> "$tmp" mv "$tmp" "$HERMES_HOME/.env" chmod 600 "$HERMES_HOME/.env" } set_env_key HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME admin set_env_key HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD "$_pw" set_env_key HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_SECRET "$_secret" _login="[hermes] FIRST LOGIN user=admin password=${_pw}" printf '%s\n' "$_login" > /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt chmod 600 /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt : > "$HERMES_HOME/MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD" chmod 600 "$HERMES_HOME/MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD" echo "[hermes] first-login password written to /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt (open it in the panel file manager)" fi unset _pw _secret _pw_line _pw_val _login || true if ! flag_on "${HERMES_ENABLE_DASHBOARD:-1}"; then echo "[hermes] ready" exec hermes gateway run fi if [ -f "$HERMES_HOME/MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "[hermes] first-run setup on port ${SERVER_PORT}: enter the one-time password from /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt, then a new password (twice, min 12 chars)" if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then _py=python3 elif [ -x "$HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python" ]; then _py="$HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python" else echo "[hermes] python3 missing" exit 1 fi "$_py" - << 'PY' import hmac import os import threading from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer from urllib.parse import parse_qs HERMES_HOME = os.environ["HERMES_HOME"] ENV_PATH = os.path.join(HERMES_HOME, ".env") MARKER = os.path.join(HERMES_HOME, "MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD") FIRST_LOGIN = "/home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt" PORT = int(os.environ["SERVER_PORT"]) USER_KEY = "HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME" PASS_KEY = "HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD" PAGE = """ Hermes password

Set a new password

{msg}




""" def dotenv_quote(value): if any(c in value for c in ("\n", "\r", "\x00")): raise ValueError("invalid password") if "'" not in value: return "'" + value + "'" escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("$", "\\$") return '"' + escaped + '"' def read_setup_token(): # The generated first-login password is the one-time setup token. val = "" if os.path.exists(ENV_PATH): with open(ENV_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as fh: for line in fh: if line.startswith(PASS_KEY + "="): val = line.split("=", 1)[1].strip() if len(val) >= 2 and val[0] == val[-1] and val[0] in ("'", '"'): val = val[1:-1] return val SETUP_TOKEN = read_setup_token() if len(SETUP_TOKEN) < 20: raise SystemExit("[hermes] one-time setup password missing; refusing to start first-run setup") def write_env(username, password): lines = [] if os.path.exists(ENV_PATH): with open(ENV_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as fh: lines = fh.read().splitlines() updates = {USER_KEY: username, PASS_KEY: dotenv_quote(password)} out = [] seen = set() for line in lines: if not line or line.lstrip().startswith("#") or "=" not in line: out.append(line) continue key = line.split("=", 1)[0] if key in updates: if key not in seen: out.append(key + "=" + updates[key]) seen.add(key) continue out.append(line) for key, value in updates.items(): if key not in seen: out.append(key + "=" + value) tmp = ENV_PATH + ".tmp" with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.write("\n".join(out) + "\n") os.chmod(tmp, 0o600) os.replace(tmp, ENV_PATH) os.chmod(ENV_PATH, 0o600) class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def log_message(self, fmt, *args): return def _send(self, code, body): data = body.encode("utf-8") self.send_response(code) self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data))) self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(data) def do_GET(self): self._send(200, PAGE.format(msg="Enter the one-time password from FIRST_LOGIN.txt, then choose a new password of at least 12 characters.")) def do_POST(self): try: n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0")) except ValueError: n = 0 if n < 0 or n > 8192: self._send(400, PAGE.format(msg="Request too large.")) return origin = self.headers.get("Origin") host = self.headers.get("Host", "") if origin and origin not in ("http://" + host, "https://" + host): self._send(403, PAGE.format(msg="Cross-origin request refused.")) return raw = self.rfile.read(n).decode("utf-8", "replace") form = parse_qs(raw, keep_blank_values=True) token = (form.get("setup_token") or [""])[0] if not hmac.compare_digest(token.encode("utf-8"), SETUP_TOKEN.encode("utf-8")): self._send(403, PAGE.format(msg="Wrong one-time password. It is in /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt.")) return pw = (form.get("password") or [""])[0] pw2 = (form.get("password2") or [""])[0] if pw != pw2 or len(pw) < 12 or any(c in pw for c in ("\n", "\r", "\x00")): self._send(400, PAGE.format(msg="Passwords must match and be at least 12 characters.")) return write_env("admin", pw) if os.path.exists(MARKER): os.remove(MARKER) if os.path.exists(FIRST_LOGIN): os.remove(FIRST_LOGIN) self._send(200, "

Password saved. Dashboard is starting. Reload this page shortly.

") threading.Thread(target=self.server.shutdown, daemon=True).start() class Server(HTTPServer): allow_reuse_address = True httpd = Server(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler) httpd.serve_forever() PY fi echo "[hermes] ready" # Dashboard is Wings PID 1 so done-regex + stop (^C) attach to it. hermes gateway run & exec hermes dashboard --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$SERVER_PORT" --no-open EOF chmod +x start.sh echo "[hermes] install complete arch=${_a}"

variables.name: Enable dashboard
variables.description: 1=dashboard on SERVER_PORT (0.0.0.0) + gateway in background (default). 0=gateway only.

variables.name: Hermes commit
variables.description: Full 40-char upstream commit SHA (v2026.9.24 = f97608f1...). Hidden from the client. Change together with HERMES_INSTALL_SHA256.

variables.name: Hermes install.sh sha256
variables.description: sha256 of scripts/install.sh at HERMES_VERSION. The installer is refused on mismatch. Hidden from the client.

variables.name: Server port
variables.description: Allocation port (from the panel; not editable).
